### Women Speaking in Church
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/women-speaking-in-church
Passage: 1 Corinthians 14:33-35
Points:
- Paul addresses orderly worship by regulating authoritative teaching in the public assembly.
- Scripture affirms women praying and prophesying while reserving the pastoral teaching office for qualified men.
- The command reflects creation order and seeks to preserve peace during corporate worship.
- Both men and women are called to learn and grow under God's Word within biblical roles.

### Power Point - Feb. 14, 2008
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-feb-14-2008-11529765.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 14:40
Points:
- Spiritual inspiration without practical organization leads to unnecessary frustration.
- God's character is demonstrated through the orderly complexity of the human body and creation.
- The local church reflects God's nature when believers coordinate their gifts and work together.
- Believers should identify disordered areas of life and commit them to God for greater effectiveness.

### A Prayer for Peace in Confusing Times - Your Daily Prayer - January 19
Author: Emily Rose Massey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-peace-in-confusing-times.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 14:33
Points:
- Conflicting messages and cultural upheaval frequently cause anxiety and mental fatigue.
- God is never the author of confusion but calls His children to walk in His peace.
- Believers can find reliable stability by filtering worldly noise through the truth of Scripture.
- Resting in God's sovereignty brings confidence even when details remain uncertain.
